# Vendored mruby-json

This directory vendors `mattn/mruby-json` at commit
`f99d9428025469f2400f93c53b185f65f963e507`.

Upstream: https://github.com/mattn/mruby-json

The gem and its bundled Parson implementation are MIT licensed. The upstream
README and the Parson copyright/license headers are retained alongside the
source. It is vendored so official extension builds remain deterministic and
do not fetch executable build inputs from the network.
